findings.description: The function embeds a static AWS access key and secret key directly in the Lambda environment variables. These values are stored in Terraform state and in the function configuration (readable via lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration), and cannot be rotated without a redeploy, so anyone with read access to state or the function obtains long-lived credentials.
The function uses the nodejs12.x runtime, which is end-of-life and no longer receives security patches, leaving the execution environment exposed to known unpatched Node.js vulnerabilities.
